corrections_to_secondary_reports: 918 has 3¼ percent in both places, not ¼ percent: the integer3 is outside MathML. Preserve neighbouring text when rendering fractions.

837 contains a half-year fraction in its first prose paragraph. Its37/29 organism counts are ordinary text; the taxon list spans multiple paragraphs with literal diag/ramme artefacts. A search for <table> is not a complete layout audit.

967F has ordered Monocot./Dicot. categories with x and ? markers, an illegible word, a ditto dash and a truncated final sentence. Do not flatten the list or treat a plant-list heading as a separate authorial turn.
843 includes the1837 agreement date after Darwin signature in the same normalized paragraph, followed by Colburn contract text. Separate at character-level, not only whole-paragraph boundaries.
905 inscription is div.supplemental inside body-content, and is authorial. The class name alone must not cause its deletion.

Human-read in the secondary visual rule was inaccurate: current readings are primary-agent source readings. A description does not make an image-dependent source automatically eligible for text-only RAFT.
Later marginal additions can already be embedded in normalized body text, as761 shows. Separating only CD-notes sibling sections is insufficient.

requirements.output_contract: The final RAFT exchange remains exactly two strings. Structured archival markup, voices, dates, source spans and asset references belong in the export sidecar. No converter or real transcript is produced by this specification.
requirements.fraction_rendering: Parse actual numerator/denominator, preserve adjacent integer, units and punctuation. Use unambiguous readable strings such as3¼,68½,1/5,1/30,9/10. Preserve original MathML plus exact DOM pointer. Never silently normalize historical arithmetic or change a source value to modern recalculation.
requirements.rows_and_lists: Preserve meaningful headings, order, row breaks, ditto signs, x/question marks, decimal points and monetary columns. Absence of an HTMLtable is no assurance that linear prose is faithful. Ambiguous diag/ramme or lost column structure remains held until source-grounded reconstruction is explicitly checked.
requirements.voice_and_versions: Use only accepted authorial spans. Keep original quotations attributed; do not flatten third-party contracts or catalogue framing into Darwin voice. Match inline additions/deletions to footnotes and layer dates. Undated later changes cannot inherit the main letter date. Preserve lacunae without inventing words.
requirements.inscriptions: Distinguish salutations, signatures, authorial cover/address instructions and modern editorial additions by provenance, not CSS class alone. Retain or explicitly omit eligible authorial inscriptions with the decision logged.
requirements.visual_eligibility: Preserve every relevant image and locator. Hold a text-only example if its question or answer depends on unrepresented visual evidence. Primary visual descriptions are modern annotations, not original correspondence; do not insert them as authentic question text. An independent supported prose-only section can be considered only when its scope remains historically coherent. Any future annotation/multimodal adapter requires explicit specification and validation.
requirements.chronology: Use a demonstrated response-section date. Track receipt, reading and later marginalia independently. Composition across days can require character-level splits; incoming serial instalments are not separate deliveries absent evidence.
requirements.verification: Before export compare rendered strings to accepted spans and raw body markup; check all mathematical/list/figure/mixed-voice cases, including target and prompt. Validate schema, contiguous numbering, target uniqueness and split/leakage policy only after cumulative historical reconciliation.
